segments.he: עַל יְדֵי הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַהִתְבּוֹדְדוּת מְהַפֵּךְ הַיְרִידָה
segments.en: The primary magnification of His glory comes through prayer — for through prayer one sees His wonders most powerfully. This path of prayer was revealed to us by our forefathers. The first was Avraham, who toiled and labored greatly in His service, broke and nullified all his desires, and surrendered his life for His sake all his days. He multiplied prayer and supplication greatly, until he drew the path of prayer into the world and established for us the morning prayer. And then came Yitzchak and Yaakov, who established the Minchah and evening prayers. And so too all the true Tzaddikim who came after them until this very day — all walked in their path and strengthened us to multiply prayer and supplication. And we must nullify our impoverished and deficient understanding and walk in the paths of our fathers and teachers, to multiply prayer about everything, and to believe that we have the power to, as it were, prevail over Him — to turn His will from judgment to mercy — even though this cannot be fully grasped. Yet the truth is as stated. And this is the full glorification of His honor, as described.

segments.he: וְזֶהוּ עִקַּר בִּרְכַּת מוֹדִים. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הַכְּרִיעָה שֶׁל מוֹדִים. כִּי הַכְּרִיעָה וְהַהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָה שֶׁמּוֹדִים לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּשֶׁנִּצּוֹלִין מֵהַצָּרָה שֶׁל הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר הַצָּרָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם כַּנַּ"ל. זֶהוּ בְּעַצְמוֹ בְּחִינַת הַיְרִידָה שֶׁנִּתְהַפְּכָה לַעֲלִיָּה. כִּי הַיְרִידָה הִוא בְּחִינַת נְפִילָה בְּחִינַת (תְּהִלִּים ע"ג) כִּמְעַט נִטָּיוּ רַגְלָי. וְהוּא בְּחִינַת (שָׁם מ"ד) כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵנוּ. וְאָז צְרִיכִין לְהִשְׁתַּטֵּחַ לִפְנֵי ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּכְרִיעָה וּבְהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָה בִּתְחִנָּה תְּפִלָּה בַּקָּשָׁה בִּבְחִינַת (אֵיכָה ג') יִתֵּן בֶּעָפָר פִּיהוּ אוּלַי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה. וְאָז כְּשֶׁהוּא חָזָק בָּזֶה כַּמְבאָר אֶצְלֵנוּ בִּמְקוֹמוֹת אֲחֵרִים בַּאֲרִיכוּת. אֲזַי זוֹכֶה שֶׁיִּתְהַפֵּךְ הַיְרִידָה לַעֲלִיָּה גְּדוֹלָה. (הִלְכוֹת נְשִׂיאַת כַּפַּיִם הֲלָכָה ד אוֹת ח):
segments.en: This is the aspect of Tefillas HaMinchah [the afternoon prayer], which is the pauper's offering, the aspect of the Prayer of the Poor. For because of all of a person's daily occupations, one rarely escapes tainted thoughts, as our Sages taught: "There are three things from which no one escapes each day." And therefore the Minchah prayer is the aspect of teshuvah [return] — for amid all one's occupations one must pause to remember Hashem and return to Him. The essential element is to forcefully tear one's mind away from impure thoughts toward good thoughts — this is the core of teshuvah. And when one has compassion on oneself and sees one's poverty and does not despair of mercy — and prays to Hashem in the aspect of the Prayer of the Poor, for one is wrapped in one's distress and has no place to flee, left or right — and yet one struggles with all one's might to flee from evil thoughts and cry out to Hashem: all this is the aspect of Tefillas HaMinchah, and through it comes the essential rectification of teshuvah.
